description: This file defines the API for controlling the auto-hinter component of the FreeType font rendering library, including properties for script mapping, fallback scripts, default scripts, x-height adjustment, and warping options.

classes.name: FT_Prop_GlyphToScriptMap
classes.description: *Experimental* *only* data structure for glyph-to-script mapping in auto-hinter control.

methods.name: FT_Property_Get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property related to auto-hinter control.

methods.name: FT_Property_Set
methods.description: Sets the value of a property related to auto-hinter control.
